name: Sonnet ~Kokoro Kasanete~
source:
Winter vacations approach and hero gets uneasy. He looks around and finds several girls that he previously considered unfriendly. Will he be able to find a familiar soul from 1st to 24th December or shall he spend Christmas alone?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
寒假临近，主人公变得不安起来。他环顾四周，发现了几个他之前认为不好相处的女孩。他能在12月1日到24日之间找到一个知心的人吗？还是将独自度过圣诞节？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
